name: Coulomb Charges
desc: A cloud of positive and negative charged particles obeying softened Coulomb law — like repels, opposite attracts — self-organizes into pulsing ionic lattices, dipole chains and plasma clumps that never stop rearranging, warm-gold and cool-cyan glows breathing on a deep indigo field.

energy.doc: glow brightness + Coulomb/repulsion force gain (first — obvious at max)

density.doc: charge count 60..220 (second — obvious crowd at max)

hue.doc: base hue of + charges (- charges take the complement)
